title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1973-03-24
source: Primary Source: Betty's 10" MSR -> PCM -> DAT supplies the 2nd Set; Secondary Sources: MSR -> C -> DAT (gd73-03-24.sbd.hamilton.shnid1216) supplies the majority of the 1st set; Betty's 10" MSR -> PCM -> S/PDIF out -> disk -> digital noise reduction w/Sound Forge 6.0 (shnid83407) supplies from 7:38 of "Here Comes Sunshine" (t15)thru the end of the 1st Set; Transfer Info: DAT -> Sony PCM R500-> Tascam DA-3000-> Adobe Audition 3.0-> TLH flac16; Transfer by Charlie Miller; Mastered by Scott Clugston

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard captures a marathon 1973 Spectrum show with a smoking Truckin' / Spanish Jam and a stellar second set.
ai_review.review: The recording is a pristine soundboard capture that lets the listener hear every nuance of this four‑hour 1973 performance. The band is in high gear, delivering an epic Truckin' (over 30 minutes) with a Spanish Jam, tight harmonies, and a second set that many reviewers call “amazing all the way through.” Minor vocal flubs are noted but do not detract from the overall fire and musicianship.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently five‑star reviews praise both the musical performance (exceptional energy, standout jams) and the recording quality (crisp, detailed soundboard). Weighted blend of show (≈70%) and recording (≈30%) yields a high overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, delicate edges; clean mix with no reported drop‑outs or major issues. Reviewers note the Alligator mods add depth but remain clear.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A massive four‑hour set that balances a gigantic first set with an exploratory, high‑energy second set; transitions flow naturally and the band maintains momentum throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Leads the way with sizzling guitar work and perfect vocals (especially on Truckin' and Goodnight).
band_member_comments.Phil: Adds free‑style noodling and deep, orchestral bass lines that complement Jerry's solos.
band_member_comments.Bob: Provides strong harmonies throughout, highlighted on Sugar Magnolia and Goodnight.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill's drumming is described as sounding like an entire orchestra, anchoring the long improvisations.
